title: A Marriage Deal with the Billionaire
description:
Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business.Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business.
But Jasper never expected his fake wife to get under his skin. And Khloe never planned to want a man she's only pretending to love. The contract had one rule — don't fall in love. Breaking it could cost them everything.

title: The Alpha's Forbidden Bunny
description: In the beastkin world, Toby (a rabbit whose impending marriage was called off) is forced into an arranged marriage with Enzo (the Wolf King and adoptive father of his former fiancée) following an unexpected one-night stand. Humiliated again and again by his ex and her family, Toby is saved by Enzo through crisis after crisis, and what begins as forced dependence slowly turns into helpless devotion — sparking a dangerous, forbidden romance defined by an extreme emotional tension.

title: Demigod Under Oath
description:
Odysseus is the secret demigod son of Apollo, bound by a deathbed vow to give his queen, Antigone, a hundred chances to earn his trust — and never seize her throne.

He turns white-haired overnight saving her kingdom from a monster, only to catch her in another man's arms. Stripped of power, tortured, framed, betrayed again and again — every wrong she commits burns away one more chance.

When the hundredth chance runs out, his true power awakens. He returns for vengeance, spear blazing with divine fire — but victory comes at the ultimate price: his own existence.

title: Devour to the God of Death from a Stray Dog
description: Trash dog’s epic counterattack! Inheriting Anubis’s legacy, he evolves by devouring everything! Tortures villains, protects his master, fights the world-destroying serpent, and finally breaks through to SSS rank as Anubis, becoming a god in one battle!

title: The Scarred Orc Who Bit Me First
description:
My Pureblood husband won't touch me. He sleeps in my stepsister's wing.
So I bought a wrecked half-blind mongrel Orc on a curb for five grand.
By dawn, his bond mark was on my throat.
By morning, three Highborn uncles were at my door.
Turns out the "low-grade" Orc I just bought is the lost heir to an eight-hundred-million-dollar Drennan estate.
And every relative in that house paid to disfigure his face when he was eight.
They're about to find out what I do to people who hurt what's mine.

title: The Arena
description: Tana is the LAST fire dragon alive—and she's hiding that secret in a cage where the losers DIE. Every night Tana heals Cedric, the wolf king locked beside her, never knowing he's her fated mate. But the second Cedric marks her and finds out she's no wolf, he LEAVES her—pregnant and alone. Now Tana is raising Cedric's secret daughter in the city… while Cedric tears apart every mountain looking for the mate he threw away.

title: Blood Lion: The Sacrificial Cage
description: After the Iron Sheep Kingdom falls, Prince Leigh is offered to Kaelen, the Blood Lion King cursed by berserker blood, becoming the “remedy” that keeps him alive. Their reunion awakens a bond forged fourteen years ago. From captor and captive to allies, they uncover the truth behind the kingdom’s fall and the curse. After surviving conspiracies, war, and sacrifice, Leigh reclaims his throne and rules alongside Kaelen.

title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands
description:
Alice is swept into the undersea world of Atlantis and becomes the mute, wicked supporting character everyone despises: the disgraced princess whose four merman husbands are ready to kill her. A healing pearl regrows her tongue, and the newly activated system sends her on missions to recover her beautiful voice and rebuild her spirit power.
Through singing and other spirit-based purification skills, Alice eases the ocean corruption driving her husbands berserk and slowly turns their resentment into trust, affection, and fierce devotion. Soon, Gunnar the shark warrior, Will the irresistible merman, Vincent the sharp-tentacled octopus, and Albert the venomous jellyfish mage - four stunning, chiseled merman husbands - are all competing to protect and spoil her.
When a two-faced rival tries to take everything Alice has reclaimed, she gives her enemy a satisfying reality check, turns the tables, and rises from Atlantis’s most unwanted woman to its most adored.

title: My Strongest Master Likes Acting Weak
description: Abe Tatum is a transmigrator and a Great Emperor. But all he wants is a peaceful life and hides his true strength at the Azure Cloud Peak. Too bad his system forces him to take in three misfits——a reincarnated Empress, a troublemaker, and a girl with massive bad luck. He wants to keep a low profile, but keeps getting dragged into conspiracies, revenge, and heavenly karmic backlash. When his home and disciples face absolute peril, Abe Tatum is forced to drop his act.

title: Just One Kiss
description: Based on the Wattpad novel by Emily Jean. Determined to lose her virginity before she starts college, Farrah Blake strikes a deal with her best friend and crush since forever, the billionaire heir Ethan Sinclair, who will find the perfect guy for her first time, or take her v-card himself.

title: I Don't Need No Alpha Brothers
description: In I Don't Need No Alpha Brothers movie, when Elara was a child, she saved Alpha Mason’s life. Out of gratitude, he took her in as his adopted daughter and brought her back to the Stormfang Pack. Mason promised that when Elara turned eighteen, she would choose one of his five sons—Ethan, Frank, Gabriel, Henry, or Ian—to marry. The six of them grew up together, inseparable, shaped by years of shared memories. Everything changed when Jenny appeared. Manipulated by her lies, the five men repeatedly hurt Elara, slowly breaking her heart. Hurt and betrayed, Elara resolves to cut ties.

title: Altarboy
description: In Altarboy movie, after getting kicked out for being gay, 18-year-old Theo is dumped at a Catholic church to be "cured" — and finds his new priest is young, hot... and a huge jerk who makes Theo his personal altar boy. What starts as a game of temptation becomes a slow-burn obsession neither can pray away, but as the game turns real, both Theo and Alexander risk losing everything to a love neither of them is supposed to want.

title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met
description: A lifetime ago, figure skating prodigy Gwen Tyler was at the top of her game and on her way to Olympic gold. But ten years later, she's stuck in a loveless engagement and a shadow of her former self. Then, her childhood best friend Aaron Lansing comes back into her life after a decade apart, and Gwen starts to realize... maybe the love she's been missing is the one she had when she was eighteen. Now she has to decide whether she's just going to keep letting life happen to her, or take back control for herself.

title: The Reckoning Takes Flight
description: Eve takes a flight to Hawaii to attend her big brother's wedding, booking an extra-wide seat because of her broken leg in a cast. A nasty woman and her bratty son demand Eve switch seats with them. The kid trips because of turbulence, his mom demands the flight turn back and fights the pilots, forcing an emergency landing. The mom's sister, Clara, shows up to back her up. Clara accuses Eve of being her fiancée's mistress, not realizing that she's her fiancée's little sister. The wedding is canceled, and Clara is sent to jail.

title: The Imperfect Marriage
description: Based on the novel by L. Steele. After her fiancé cheats on her, Vivian flash marries a hot silver fox… only to realize he’s her ex’s dad. The deal is simple: two weeks of marriage, a CEO title for Quentin and enough money for Vivian to save her sick dad. But as her ex keeps humiliating her and his dad keeps saving her, Vivian's fake marriages starts to cross very real lines.

title: Race and Rise: My Machine Girls
description: In the Mecha Age, girls who turn 18 can transform into powerful mechas and go to the battlefield, while men can become Pilots and lead them to glory in combat. Ethan awakens as an SSS-rank Pilot. Waiting for him are beautiful Mecha Girls, each with her own unique personality, advanced combat skills, ever-evolving weapons and energy systems. But every victory only leads him to more challenges, where even his SSS-rank power will be put to the ultimate test. As his enemies go after him, Ethan must grow stronger, master his Mecha Girls, and fight his way toward the top.

title: Found A Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas
description: Victoria was set to return to Texas with her fiancé Carl to plan their wedding, but she was horrifically humiliated and betrayed by him. To save face with her family, Victoria reluctantly agrees to marry Simon, a homeless man she had been helping. Little did she know, Simon is not just any homeless man—he's a handsome and charming billionaire, the CEO of the prestigious Savage Group, ranked number one in the country. Upon returning to Texas with Simon, Victoria unexpectedly crosses paths with her arrogant ex, Carl. This time, she’s determined to reclaim all the dignity she lost.

title: Is It Just Me?
description: A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.

title: Their Brother Lost in Space
description: In Their Brother Lost in Space movie, Timothy, adopted by the wealthy Snyder family, grows up devoted to his three older sisters — until the day their biological son, Matthew, returns and turns them against him with lies and manipulation. Cast out and blamed for things he never did, Timothy still repays their kindness: he saves them, sacrifices for them, and even secretly volunteers for Project Hail Mary, a mission to save humanity by sending one person with a rare gene into find a new planet. Only after he's gone, do the Snyders discover the truth about Matthew's schemes and Timothy's sacrifices. Thirty years later, Timothy succeeds on Planet Artemis, honored as a hero while his grieving family lives with the cost of their betrayal.

title: True Heiress vs. Fake Queen Bee
description:
Hailey Kaplan, a wealthy teenager who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to Western High, a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hailey hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life.
However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Candice Mathis, the daughter of the Kaplan family's maid, arrives at school posing as the Kaplan heiress. Candice quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hailey finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.

title: Hey Boss, Your Company is Getting Bombed
description: In Hey Boss Your Company is Getting Bombed movie, Clyde is a middle-aged salesman who has been marginalized in his job. One day, he wakes up with a superpower of seeing when and how people would die. He tries to save multiple people from death, but no one believes him. A few days later, his power tells him there is going to be an explosion at his company that will kill everyone in the building. To save everyone, he has to find out who planted the bomb and stop them.

title: Cooking My Way Back to Love
description: Chef Leon Kennedy, once the "King of Cooking," fell apart after his wife died in a tragic car accident. His deep depression led him to fall into homelessness, losing everything except his beloved dog, Dante. A restaurant owner takes him in, giving him a job, not knowing who he is. Working in the kitchen, he faces the abuse of the executive sous chef (Bryant), who belittles and disrespects him. Leon tries to keep his head down, but when a nefarious businessman (William) threatens the restaurant, Leon has to break out the skills and artistry that made him a legendary chef. The restoration of his glory and joy is shortlived, however, as the spiteful chef Bryant defames him, and the resentful William kills his beloved dog. Enduring ups, downs, and devastation once again, the aggrieved Chef Leon picks up his chef's knife, hungry for revenge.

title: Dominated by My Dad's Boss
description:
Based on the novel by Havley McQueen, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish.
When Jayne Turner asks a stranger at a bondage party to teach her how to be a dominatrix, she has no idea he’ll turn out to be the man overseeing her father’s exit from the family company. What’s meant to be a single night of education about dominance and submission turns into something more when Jayne asks Dom to continue teaching her. Because of a morality clause in his contract, a relationship with her could mean his job if anyone finds out, but Dom agrees. They must keep their relationship strictly educational and entirely undercover, but as their passion grows, so does the risk of discovery. Jayne’s success on the movie set is thanks to Dom’s “instruction,” but as she begins receiving increasingly more threatening messages tying her to her deceased mother, famous actress Ingrid Hart, it's up to Dom to protect what he owns. With multiple enemies possibly behind the threats, Jayne isn’t sure who to blame. It turns out to be the gaffer on set, a man who’d worked with and been obsessed with Ingrid. Doug kidnaps Jayne but her quick thinking has Dom on the way to rescue her – which reveals their relationship and triggers the morality clause. Dom makes a deal with Jayne’s dad without her knowledge. Dad will back off trying to stop Jayne’s movie career, and Dom will return to London, never to see her again. The night of Jayne’s movie premiere, Dad reveals the truth and Jayne reaches out to the man she’s fallen in love with. At her message, Dom returns to beg forgiveness for leaving her. Jayne forgives them, and they can be together openly.

title: The Lost Quarterback Returns
description: In The Lost Quarterback Returns movie, when Asher Bradshaw, the son of hall-of-famer NFL quarterback Trent Bradshaw and former beauty queen Krista, goes missing in a devastating fire, psychotic fan Donny Lewis takes it as an opportunity to swap Asher with his own son, Wyatt. Twelve years later, the two boys cross paths at football tryouts where Asher out performs Wyatt. The Bradshaw's not realizing Asher is their long-lost son, attack him relentlessly. They put him through physical and mental torture, egged on by their adoptive son. Until they uncover the shocking truth—Asher's the one they've been looking for. The Bradshaws then do everything in their power to beg for forgiveness while Wyatt and Donny plot revenge.

title: High Society
description: In High Society movie, Adele was born with nothing: no last name, no family, no home. But then she meets Cesare Buonaparte. The Duke. The most feared man on their island nation. And finally, she has a chance to become something more. To bring herself out of poverty and save her friend's life, she makes a deal with the Duke: she'll help him escape an arranged marriage by pretending to be his long-lost sister. Though he's the most gorgeous, infuriating man she's ever met, siblings—even fake ones—can never fall in love. So... why does he keep looking at her like that?

title: Mistaken as His Mate: The Luna’s Regret
description: In Mistaken as His Mate The Luna’s Regret movie, Alpha Caspian’s pregnant sister Marina arrives for his Luna’s coronation, but Luna Willow mistakes her for a rogue mistress. In a jealous rage, Willow bullies Marina, causing her miscarriage. Now the Brooks siblings want blood.

title: My X-Ray Vision Sees Right Through You
description: In My X-Ray Vision Sees Right Through You movie, after his girlfriend dumps him, Eric, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant global influencer bullies, all while winning the heart of his high school's most popular girl.

title: How to Dump a Hockey Star
description: In How to Dump a Hockey Star movie: After leaving behind her life as a billionaire heiress, Renee dedicates herself to helping her husband recover from a vegetative state and pursue his NHL dreams. However, after suffering a devastating miscarriage, she is faced with a brutal truth: the man she sacrificed everything for might have chosen someone else.

title: Move Aside! I'm the Final Boss
description: In Move Aside I'm the Final Boss Movie, Kingsley is the secret King of King's Corps and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?

title: The Unbreakables: Super Son Returns
description: Kit vanishes at age seven in a robot attack, raised by kidnapper Voltage as "Ash." Later, Ash infiltrates his family's tryouts, framed by brother Spark, Voltage's son. His birthmark nearly surfaces, Aura's intuition circles, and their father doubts him, until Spark burns the mark away. When Voltage publicly claims Ash, the family erupts into war. Ash proves his bloodline and helps them escape. He regains his memory at the crater, reclaims the name Kit Unbreakable, Spark's betrayal unresolved.

title: LadyAid: From Dumped Pauper to Tycoon
description: After his greedy girlfriend dumps him, Cole Preston awakens the LadyAid System and gains immense wealth by helping women. He rises from obscurity to become a hidden billionaire, building a vast empire and forming complicated relationships with powerful women. When his ex launches a smear campaign, Cole's allies expose her lies, leading to her arrest. With his enemies defeated, Cole reaches the pinnacle of wealth and power.

title: Don't Wake the Dead Man
description: On Tidewater Station, dockhand Cole Andrews keeps his head down, takes the abuse, and raises his daughter alone. But when a rigged debt puts fifteen-year-old Kira in the fight ring, the station starts asking who her father really is - and so does the Syndicate that has spent fifteen years hunting a dead man.

title: Agent Badboy
description: In AGENT BADBOY movie, top FBI agent Buddy looks exactly like Barton, the deceased patriarch of the Logut mafia family. He goes undercover as Barton to expose the family’s arms smuggling. Inside, he survives power grabs from Luca, probes from Barton’s stepmother Susanna, and uses their shared crescent birthmark to avoid exposure. He falls for Barton’s wife Elise, wins over bodyguard Haruko, and secures the San Francisco docks. With evidence in hand, he and FBI Deputy Director Helena plan a final raid—but FBI Director Burke is the mafia’s deepest mole. He and the Raine family spring a trap; Helena is shot. In the battle, Buddy kills Burke and Carlos. Dying, Burke reveals Buddy and Barton are twin brothers—stolen as infants and groomed to be a mafia mole inside the FBI. Torn between two bloodlines, Buddy stands with Elise, Susanna, and Haruko—as Helena, presumed dead, twitches her fingers. Cliffhanger.

title: Full Court Legend
description: In 2006, Marcel "The Sniper" Wallace wins THE LEAGUE title, then loses his wife to rival Tyler Murray's hitman. He vanishes into a fast-food job for twenty years. Lured back as coach, he reunites with his resentful son Mars, a LEAGUE star. Marcel proves himself through impossible shots while Murray escalates to kidnapping and blackmail. At the Hall of Fame, Marcel reveals his identity and Murray confesses to murder. Victory comes when Mars accepts twenty unsent birthday letters and they embrace.

title: Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with
description: After three years of hidden trial in a homeless camp, Vince Astor is crowned America's Godfather, heir to $20.9 billion. He keeps the secret when Helen Stark, the CEO he saved two years ago, proposes to him on the street. Still dressed as a bum, he follows her home and swallows her family's scorn as they force her to marry Philip West. His power then surfaces layer by layer. A bank president kneels, a $1 billion bid lands, an underboss kisses his ring. Helen chooses him anyway, for who he is.

title: How the Tech Genius Stole Back Christmas (updating)
description: Elijah Greene is lead programmer at Gray Tech, the top tech company in the world. After he's unfairly sacked on Christmas Eve by the CEO's daughter, Samantha Gray, he's recruited by Ava Cross, a high-ranking employee at Gray Tech competitor Eagle Tech and also Elijah's ex-girlfriend. When Ava's attempts to hire Elijah are met with resistance by Elijah's resentful relatives and the evil, power-hungry Henderson family, Elijah and Ava join forces with the CEOs of Gray Tech and Eagle Tech to start their own company and take their rightful positions atop the tech industry.

title: The Secret Billionaire's Unexpected Bride
description: Scarlett, a kind‑hearted and resilient delivery rider, enters a flash marriage with Ethan, the CEO of Imperial Group who is disguised as a poor young man, in order to hold onto her late mother’s keepsakes. As they live together after marriage, feelings gradually blossom between them. Behind the scenes, Ethan helps her resolve workplace crises. When his true identity as a corporate president comes to light, his former fiancée teams up with their bitter rival to set her up. Amid life‑threatening danger, Scarlett recognizes her true feelings, and the two finally rebuild their trust hand‑in‑hand.

title: Runaway Single Mom, Safe in His Arms
description: In Runaway Single Mom Safe in His Arms movie, single mom Maria escapes abuse and fights to protect her daughter, Judy. From factory struggles to elite schools, she faces enemies, family betrayal, and unexpected love. When billionaire Levi enters her life, everything changes...

title: The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War
description: In The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War movie, to protect his wife, God King Kairos sealed his divine powers and feigned being a worthless mortal. Instead of gratitude, Cassia returned bearing her lover's child, demanding the family relic while humiliating him publicly. Driven past his limit, Kairos shattered his shackles, awakening his supreme godhood. He exposed her lover as an abyssal spy, leading to the traitor's execution. Begging for mercy, Cassia fled in exile, as the God King reclaimed his absolute throne.

title: The Dragon King's Slave Mate
description: Saria, an abused village girl, is seized by Dragon King Alarik, whose touch triggers an unprecedented Mark binding them as mates. Alarik hides their bond behind a slave collar. Amid Xander's suspicion and Celeste's schemes, Saria survives a slave hunt and discovers she can bend dragon fire. Alarik reveals his death curse: one month to live. Xander exposes the Mark and attacks; Saria channels blue fire to destroy him. Their first kiss seals the bond, but Celeste offers silence at an unnamed cost.

title: Fake Angel's Final Fall
description: Billion-dollar conglomerate founder Sarah returns home, keeping her wealth hidden, hoping only for a quiet wedding. Unexpectedly, Hailey, her son's fiancée, humiliates her relentlessly to seize her wedding venue — completely unaware that the victim before her is none other than her fiancé's own mother! Hailey resorts to extreme violence. She shoots Sarah and has her bound and drowned in a resort pool to silence her. Miraculously surviving, Sarah refuses her son's protection. Disguised as a waitress, she infiltrates the engagement gala. Before the city's elite and assembled media, witnesses and irrefutable evidence come to light, exposing Hailey’s full conspiracy: fake-pregnancy fraud, embezzlement, and attempted murder. The villain is publicly ruined. Sarah makes her triumphant return, reclaiming everything that belongs to her!

title: After the Sacred Whale Betrayed Me, I Contracted Poseidon
description: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Whale Neil, take human form—only to have Neil pierce her heart and push her into the Bloodtide Trench the moment he transformed. Reborn on the day of the contract ceremony, Layla abandons the Sacred Whale and chooses a dying little spirit snake instead. Neil, now in human form, teams up with her sister Evelyn to humiliate her, but the little snake turns out to be Poseidon, the Sea Emperor. As past betrayals and old wounds resurface, Neil kneels in regret—too late. Only Poseidon stands by her side. This time, Layla will never waste herself on the unworthy again, and finally learns to live for herself.

title: Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen
description: In the Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen movie, after her Moonshadow Pack was slaughtered by rogues, Arya, the werewolf warrior, hides her immense power to honor her mother's dying wish. She marries Alpha Micah, and hides her strength. But then, Alpha Micah breaks his vows and returns from war with a new mate, Vera, and demands that Arya share her Luna title with her. Faced with Vera, Micah, and his family's cruelty, Arya can no longer bear it. She leaves Micah and unleashes the immense power of the White Wolf, reclaiming what is hers with the help of Lowe, the Lycan King. After separating from Micah, Arya discoveres that Vera not only stole Micah from her, but is also the traitor who slaughtered her parents and the Moonshadow Pack. Arya rushes to the battlefield to face her betrayers, and in the process, finds love in Lowe, the Lycan King.

title: Flash Vows
description: They mistook each other for the partner in the contractual marriage. After the flash marriage, they discovered that they were meant for each other.

title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle
description:
Reborn heiress Emily remembers everything - the false accusations, her family's betrayal, and her death at Olivia's hands. Now armed with knowledge of the past, how will she handle the fake heiress who destroyed her life?
Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap—engineered to make Caroline appear engaged in inappropriate physical contact with Liam's uncle, Connor, right in front of Liam. This misunderstanding led to their divorce, and Caroline was driven out of the household. Heartbroken, Caroline returned to her family, determined to take revenge against her ex-husband and his relatives. Yet, amidst her quest for vengeance, she unexpectedly developed profound feelings for Connor. Meanwhile, after discovering his mother and Natty’s plot to frame Caroline, Liam became determined to win her back. Now torn between Connor—her mature and alluring current husband—and Liam, the man she once deeply loved, Caroline faces an agonizing choice: which path should she take?

title: Married In A Heartbeat
description: Betrayed by her fiance and her own sister, Esther marries Ricky without knowing his real identity – a secret billionaire. Together, they have to stand up against Esther's evil family, take back her mother’s company and find their happy ending.

title: His Defective Robot Boyfriend
description: In Boston of 2049, after the Global Data Collapse wiped out massive digital archives, androids have woven themselves into human society. Alden Shaw, chief emotionalAI engineer at Wren Robotics, rescues prototype EL0 marked for disposal and labelled defective. He names him Elio. What begins as a technical rescue gradually blooms into a bond crossing the line between human and machine. Elio repeatedly breaks the Three Restrictions programmed into androids, developing jealousy, longing, possessiveness and selfsacrificing love. Drawn into corporate conspiracies, they uncover Gideon’s greed, Silas’ hidden agenda, and Julian’s unfinished hidden core. They are forced to confront one devastating question: is an android’s love merely code and command, or the genuine affection of a freewilled being?

title: Fated To My Billionaire Call Boy
description: Diane makes a deathbed promise to her grandmother to have a baby—only to immediately uncover proof of her husband Miles' affair. Devastated, she ends their seven-year marriage. In a drunken rebound move (courtesy of her bold bestie Maggie), Diane spends a wild night with a gorgeous callboy named Eddie… but her night blindness hides a jaw-dropping truth:  Eddie is actually Dominic—her and Miles'college classmate who's been secretly in love with her for years. After studying abroad, he's now returned as a ruthless billionaire… and he'll stop at nothing to win Diane back. By day, he's a powerful tycoon; by night, he voluntarily plays her devoted callboy, determined to make her fall for him.

title: Five Years of Secret Love, He Married My Best Friend
description: Harper has been in a secret romantic relationship with Alpha Connor for five long years. She waits patiently, hoping her lover will make their bond public and stand with her under the Moon Goddess for a sacred wolf‑clan moon‑vow ceremony. Instead, she discovers Connor is about to hold this very ritual with Maddie — her best friend of more than ten years. Connor claims registering as Maddie's official mate and going through the vow ceremony is only a practical measure. Maddie's father is critically ill and requires the spousal‑level pack medical benefits to afford his treatment. He begs Harper for understanding, yet he comfortably plays the perfect fiancé in Maddie's household. All those times he turned down Harper's invitations to go home for holidays under the excuse of work, he was actually staying by Maddie's side. To make the farce complete, Connor and Maddie pressure Harper into working as Maddie's maid of honor. They weaponize small‑town gossip and community reputation, forcing her to swallow five years of devotion and heartbreak for the sake of their dignified ceremony. On the day of the moon‑vow, Harrison, Connor's fierce business rival from the Blackstone Pack, crashes the event and exposes Connor's hypocrisy. To shield her family from vicious local rumors, Harper makes a desperate public lie: she announces Harrison is her boyfriend. Harrison quickly plays along and slips into the fake‑boyfriend role. Plunged into regret after losing Harper, Connor spirals into obsessive pursuit, desperate to annul his mate record with Maddie and win her back. Maddie, in turn, pours out years of pent‑up jealousy, confessing how she has always resented living in Harper's shadow. With her five‑year secret romance shattered beyond repair, Harper turns her back on her self‑delusional ex‑lover and her treacherous best friend. She refuses to compromise for a broken relationship, reclaims her self‑respect, and steps forward toward a new life.

title: Don’t Mess with My Lethal Fiancée
description: Scarlett disappears after a one-night stand with wealthy heir Landon while she is on the run. Later, entrusted by her mentor, she

title: Chained by Hades, the Underworld King
description:
Elena, the daughter of the Lord of Yalkreon, ventures out in search of sacred tree sap to save her mother from a deadly ice curse. Along the way, she unexpectedly rescues Hades, King of the Underworld, who immediately decides to make her his queen.
But Elena is betrayed by her fiancé, then forcibly sold as a sacrifice to the Lord of the Frostlands by her cruel stepmother and greedy father. Just as all hope is lost during the sacrificial ceremony, Hades descends in overwhelming force, punishes everyone who has wronged her, and takes her back to the Underworld under his protection.

title: Slimmed Down, My Wolf Crush Recognized Me
description: Four years ago, Elena was a 200-pound Omega girl who secretly loved Victor, the most admired Alpha at their werewolf academy. On graduation night, one room card and a cruel misunderstanding turned her first love into her deepest humiliation. She disappeared, changed her name to Lena, lost the weight, and raised their son alone. Now she's back as a team doctor for Victor's hockey team. He doesn't recognize her at first—but he can't stop watching her. Then her three-year-old son calls him “Dad.” As old bullies expose her past and the internet turns against her, Victor finally learns the truth: the woman he lost four years ago has been beside him all along.

title: Secretly Pregnant with the Billionaire's Daughter
description: Six years ago, college student Isabel was framed, leading to an unexpected encounter with billionaire heir Ethan, after which she became pregnant and dropped out of school. Six years later, Isabel works tirelessly to raise her child, who suffers from severe allergies. By a twist of fate, she joins Ethan's company and becomes his personal assistant. Faced with relentless bullying and even life-threatening schemes against her child by the vicious heiress Rachel, Isabel refuses to back down and bravely fights back. As they spend time together day and night, Ethan not only repeatedly steps in to save her but also falls deeply in love with her. As the plot unfolds, the child's true bloodline identity is unexpectedly revealed to Ethan's family, specifically his great-grandmother, Olivia. In the end, the malicious Rachel faces the consequences of her actions and is handed over to the police. Isabel unexpectedly becomes pregnant with twins—a boy and a girl—and shares a grand, perfectly happy ending with Ethan.

title: The Big Wife's Revenge: From Model to Queen
description: Sophia finally marries Damien, the man she’s loved for ten years—only to have her dream marriage shattered by humiliation, betrayal, and his scheming assistant. Heartbroken, she walks away and transforms herself inside and out. Three months later, Sophia returns stunning, confident, and determined to live for herself. But just as she stops chasing Damien, her arrogant husband realizes he’s fallen for her—and now he’ll do anything to win his wife back.

title: The Alpha Made His Savior the Pack's Slave
description: Aria Voss lost her voice and scarred her face dragging Alpha Damon Kade out of a wolfsbane fire. Three years later, Damon believes Vivienne, the woman wearing Aria's stolen pendant, is his savior. He calls Aria a liar, gives her to his warriors as a reward, and ties her to the border for execution. Aria has no voice, no wolf, and no pack left to trust. Then Frostfang's Caleb cuts her free. With her voice returning and her pendant back in hand, Aria walks into Blackthorn as Ravyn Vale to expose the fraud and reject the Alpha who ruined her.

title: My Possessive Ex-Husband
description: Five years ago, gifted surgeon Elara Voss fled a suffocating marriage while secretly carrying her husband’s unborn daughter. Now, one drunken mistake lands her back in bed with her cold, billionaire ex‑husband, Damian Sterling. Determined to protect their five‑year‑old daughter, Elara insists the child isn’t his and proposes a strictly physical arrangement: Tuesdays only, no publicity, no interference, and no entanglement. What she doesn’t know is that Damian has loved her for five full years and waited for her all along; he simply never knew how to express his feelings. As old desire reignites, their daughter’s identity and the carefully staged fake‑infidelity hoax that destroyed their marriage begins to surface. Can two people who never learned to understand each other’s love give their marriage a second chance once the truth comes to light?

title: Swapped Bride: Awakening of the True Princess
description:
The Kingdom of Silver Moon must send a princess to wed the King of the Wildlands. Two princesses, Maeve and Lila, draw lots to decide who will be married off to that barren land. Lila begs Maeve to go in her place.

Then Maeve remembers her last life. She stayed — and married Asher, the general who had been her childhood sweetheart. Their marriage turned bitter, and they spent a lifetime hating each other. On the day the city fell, Asher died shielding her escape, and with his last breath he begged her to let him be with Lila. Maeve had spent a whole life and never won his heart. She threw herself from the cliff to follow him in death.

Reborn, Maeve finally sees clearly: this time, she will give Asher and Lila her blessing.

title: Pucked in the Friend Zone
description: In Pucked in the Friend Zone movie, when Reese unexpectedly reunites with her ex-best friend and first love Grayson four years after he broke her heart, she agrees to pose as his fake girlfriend for his sister's wedding. But as old feelings threaten to bubble out, Reese must decide if a chance at true love is worth the risk of repeating history.

title: Daddy Help! Mommy’s in Prison!
description: In Daddy Help Mommy’s in Prison movie, when a powerful CEO discovers his daughter and frees his college sweetheart from prison, they must overcome years of resentment and sacrifice to protect their child from those who tore them apart.

title: I Married the Alpha They Threw Away
description: After being betrayed by her Alpha mate and watching him lead the pack to slaughter both her and her newborn daughter, Lyra is given a second life. This time, she rejects fate, chooses a new mate, and awakens the legendary White Wolf. As the truth behind the pureblood bloodline unravels, the Alpha realizes he destroyed the very bloodline his family hunted for generations. But when Lyra becomes pregnant again, the hunt begins once more.

title: Marked by the Wolf King, I Return With My Fierce Cub
description: On the night of a full moon, the Werewolf King Cain loses control and has a sexual encounter with a human girl named Jenny; she subsequently leaves, unaware that she is carrying the Wolf King's heir. She struggles to protect her pregnancy while enduring abuse from her cold-hearted father, cruel stepmother, and greedy younger brother, eventually giving birth prematurely to a half-breed son, Sammy. To cover exorbitant medical bills, she works odd jobs by day and sells alcohol in nightclubs by night, suffering endless humiliation. Amidst this desperate situation, she reunites with the child's father, Cain. Together, they mature through power struggles and family conspiracies, safeguarding a love that transcends the boundaries between their species.

title: Run, Mommy! Daddy Is Coming!
description: Actress Lily had a one‑night stand with CEO Liam five years ago and returned home raising their son Leo alone. Leo accidentally recognizes his biological father, and a DNA test confirms their blood ties. The two sign a contract for a secret marriage. As Lily struggles in show business, she faces rumors and rivals’ harassment. She also deals with the pursuit of movie star Mason and hostility from actress Lucy. Quietly resolving troubles for her, Liam gradually falls for her and chases her heart. With the clever little son playing matchmaker, this fake couple slowly develops genuine feelings for each other.

title: Becoming the Heirless Dragon King's Fated Mate
description: Laura, sold to a violent old man, escapes into a cave and bonds with silver dragon duke Kyle—becoming pregnant with his heir. They marry for the child, then fall in love. Despite rival schemes and assassination attempts, Laura discovers runemaster talent, gives birth to twins, founds an academy, and stands equal beside Kyle.

title: Married Off To The Cursed Alpha Daddy
description: Meara's cruel stepmother and half sister marry her off to Damian, a poor, cursed Alpha and single father to his disabled daughter, Sierra. Wolfless and trapped in the mountains, Meara struggles to survive—especially with Violet, the pack woman determined to have Damian for herself. As Violet plots to destroy her, Meara fights to protect her new family and reclaim her wolf. But Damian isn't the weak, cursed Alpha everyone believes him to be... He is the Supreme Alpha, and her fated mate.

title: The Price of Losing Her
description: On her wedding anniversary, doctor Aria is assigned an unexpected patient: Abigail, her husband’s first love. And standing beside Abigail at her appointment is none other than Aria’s husband, Michael. That day, Aria makes two life-changing decisions. First, get rid of the husband. Second, get rid of his baby. She calmly ends her marriage and terminates her pregnancy, then disappears from Michael’s life without ever telling him. When Michael finally learns that Aria left him—and that she had been carrying his child before—he is forced to face the truth about his feelings. But by then, Aria has already started a new life. And in the end, all Michael can do is watch the woman he lost walk into a future without him.

title: I Flew Home Pregnant Only To See His Secret
description: On her 7th anniversary, pregnant Amelia finds husband Trevor dining with another woman. She leaves Boston, files for divorce using a prenup clause he wrote, and reclaims her hidden identity as Dr. Amelia Voss—co‑founder of Longmoor Labs and creator of VESL. As she rebuilds her career and custody of daughter Adi, Trevor’s world crumbles. With support from her grandmother, loyal colleagues, and quiet suitor Hugh, Amelia wins sole custody, 75% assets, and a new life. Trevor loses everything—too late, he finally sees who she truly is.

title: Daddy, We’re Secret Billionaires
description: Seven-year-old genius Daisy concealed her identity as the heir to a top-tier wealthy family. While secretly manipulating the stock market and controlling a large conglomerate, she quietly supported her ordinary father, Richard. At bidding conferences, at school, and at class reunions, she repeatedly humiliated the rich kids who looked down on Richard, step by step helping her father get to know Lila, a woman of quality. In the end, she publicly revealed her hidden identity as the wealthiest person in the shadows, shaking up the entire Los Angeles business world.

title: Mommy, I Found a Brother!
description:
"Five years ago, Nora gave birth to boy‑girl twins, only to be told her son was stillborn. In truth, Vanessa bribed doctors to steal the baby boy as her bargaining chip to marry into a wealthy family.

Five years later, her daughter Daisy “picks up” a little boy at a hotel — her long‑lost brother Theo. Nora is hired to look after Theo and discovers that Grant, the boy’s uncle, is the man she spent one night with five years ago, and the biological father of both children.

Fearing the wealthy family will take her daughter away, Nora conceals Daisy’s real age. Meanwhile, the two kids are busy playing matchmaker for their mother. As they increasingly look like a family of four, Vanessa grows frantic. The son she stole, the marriage she faked, and the secret behind her husband’s fatal car accident are on the verge of being exposed."

title: Carrying the Oil Baron's Four Heirs
description:
"Carrying the Oil Baron’s Four Heirs follows Quinn Calloway, a broke veterinary student who makes a desperate one-night deal with Texas oil-and-ranch heir Wyatt Sterling to save her dying mother. Three months later, Quinn discovers she is pregnant with quadruplets — and the father is the billionaire uncle of her cruel ex-boyfriend, Brett.
But the Sterling family will changes everything: Wyatt must marry and prove an heir is on the way before his thirtieth birthday, or the entire Sterling ranch and oil empire will pass to Brett. The four babies Quinn carries become the only thing standing between a dynasty and ruin, pulling her into a high-stakes battle of inheritance, revenge, forbidden love, and family betrayal."

title: The Alpha and Beta's Shared Mate
description:
I’ve been dreading my eighteenth birthday for as long as I can remember. My mating day was even worse than I could have imagined.  Not only was I mated to the Alpha and the Beta, they don’t want me.
Publicly cast aside for another woman, I fled into the wilderness, entirely unaware that I was actually a forbidden wolf-vampire hybrid. To protect me from a corrupt Council, my family wiped my memories, leaving me stranded in a rogue town as "Katie"—heavily pregnant and completely lost.
But my past violently caught up when my mates and their secret Alpha brother, Mason, tracked me down. With a dark conspiracy now targeting my newborn daughter to breed a lethal hybrid army, I must survive a volatile web of dangerous desires to protect my child before a brutal war consumes us all.

title: Waterboy: Second Down
description: Three years after Kaden broke Donovan’s heart to save his NFL dreams, superstar quarterback Donovan Miller is back — and signed wi

title: Waterboy
description: Student Body President Kaden Russell just made an enemy of Star Quarterback Donovan Miller. When the two clash over school activit

title: Pucked and Pregnant
description: When Logan Everett rescues Alexis Lee from her abusive boyfriend, a night of passion leads to pregnancy. As their feelings deepen

title: Sleeping with the President
description: Mia needs her wedding planning business to succeed to pay for her sister’s medical treatment. But when she falls for the groom–pre

title: The Senator's Son
description: Emma Andrews wants to lead a quiet life in college but that’s impossible when Zach Walker, son of a famous senator and hottest guy

title: Swept Away by My Janitor Husband
description: Ethan, the CEO of Rutherford Enterprises, is undercover as a janitor to uncover a company mole. However, his secret identity compl

title: The Genius and the Bad Boy
description: When two hot brothers go after plus size Sophie, will she pick the true-hearted bad boy or the lying quarterback?

title: Baby Daddy Goals
description: When Becca Morris gets a soccer scholarship to her dream school, Cliffton College, she gets some startling news alongside her orie

title: Shhh, Professor! Please Don't Tell
description: Ellie is living a double life as a student by day, masked stripper by night. When the handsome Jackson Steele walks into the club,

title: The Ultimate Fight for Love
description: After her parents' mysterious deaths, Harper finds herself deep in debt to shady businessman Travis Noble, who forces her to spy o

title: The Triplets' Final Regret
description:
In The Triplets' Final Regret movie, Elisa, a half-human, half-vampire girl, believes the Lockhart triplets are the only people in the world she can truly trust. She wants to become human for them—and spend forever with one of them.

But everything changes when Amber, the maid’s daughter, appears. Again and again, Elisa is abandoned, humiliated, and stripped of her dignity. All for Amber. Finally, she decides to let go and accept her fate: leaving day school behind, transferring to night school, and becoming a vampire.

But when Elisa appears in her night school uniform, held in the arms of a powerful vampire heir, why do the triplets who once threw her away suddenly fall into regret and panic—kneeling before her, begging for forgiveness?

title: My Second Life as a Billionaire Heiress
description: Exploited and sold off by her adoptive family, reborn genius Scout uses DNA matching to reunite with her biological father—Dominic Moretti, America’s supreme Mafia don. Backed by three elite brothers, she debuts as the sole Moretti heiress at her coming-of-age gala, exposes her abusers, and claims her place at the top.

title: Wrong Door Right Girl
description:
Paige, a struggling aspiring musician, dreams of getting into the Royal Academy of Music, but the application fees are impossible. At the homecoming party, she plans to confess to her crush Vera—but in her nervous rush, she knocks on the wrong door and finds Talia, the star cheerleading captain, just after discovering her boyfriend Derek's infidelity.

Talia proposes a fake-girlfriend contract: Paige pretends to date her until the National Cheerleading Championship. In return, Talia helps Paige join the music club and raise funds. They face campus gossip and Derek's vicious retaliation, and their fake romance slowly turns real.

Derek spreads lies. Talia's controlling mother uses money and media to tear them apart. A severe ankle injury threatens Talia's cheer career. Misunderstandings pull them apart. With support from friends and her brother, Paige accepts herself, exposes Derek, and passes her academy audition with her original song "Cheer for My Heart." She rushes to the championship and confesses publicly. Defying class prejudice, the two girls bravely choose their future together.

title: They Bet on My Tears
description: Aria hides her identity as the sole heiress of America's richest family and enters college disguised as a scholarship student to evaluate her arranged fiancé. Instead, she becomes the target of a cruel dating game where wealthy students compete to break girls' hearts for money. She plays along until the night they publicly dump and humiliate her. Just when everyone expects tears, Aria ends the game with a single phone call. Their fortunes, reputations, and futures begin collapsing one by one. But the revenge she prepared is far from over.

title: Nanny to the Boy Who Hates Me
description: Scholarship student Abbi is bullied by Felix at Camden Prep, yet poverty forces her into his home as live-in nanny. Hatred turns to desire: Felix confesses cruelty masked attraction; Abbi sees his protective side. But his abusive father Scott forbids romance on pain of dismissal. Braving blackmail, viral humiliation, and a rival's sabotage, they love in secret. Felix uses years of recorded abuse evidence to banish Scott, freeing them both. Abbi earns Oxford and Head Girl, enemies become lovers.

title: Prep School Pop Star!
description: Secret heiress Ariana is the angelic voice behind her best friend's fame. When that bestie steals her boyfriend too, Ariana's childhood friend—the school heartthrob and MVP —comes back.

title: Bully Me? I Run the Mob!
description: Will O'Connell, the city's most powerful mafia boss, dies saving an overweight, bullied teenager, Cayden, only to awaken in the boy's body. Forced back into high school, Will quickly clashes with campus bully Dane. After enduring a brutal public beating, he shocks everyone by knocking Dane down with a single punch. With help from his trusted confidant Vinny, Will secretly regains control of the O'Connell family while posing as his own illegitimate son. Using mafia resources, he transforms Cayden's body, returns to school in spectacular fashion, humiliates Dane, defeats a vindictive teacher with his academic brilliance, and survives an assassination attempt.

title: Tempted by My Bad Boy Stepbrother
description: In Tempted by my bad boy stepbrother movie, Olivia has secretly loved her stepbrother Jacob for years — but ever since their parents' wedding, he's treated her like a stranger. He races motorcycles and lives on the edge; she's the golden girl who never breaks a rule. When one reckless night forces them together, buried feelings start clawing their way to the surface. Some lines were never meant to be crossed.

title: Divorced: Claimed by the Mafia King
description: Claire Hayes is left with nothing after her divorce from Preston Hollis. With nowhere else to turn, she takes a job as the contract wife of Rafael Moretti, the most feared Don in New York. His son, who refuses to speak to anyone, starts calling her Mom. Little by little, Rafael falls for her too. Preston comes crawling back—first begging, then threatening, then trying to have her killed. Too late. The woman he threw away is now Rafael's real wife and the Queen of the underworld.

title: After My Three Alpha Childhood Sweethearts Abandoned Me, They Regretted It
description: Orphan Eileen saved Hatton Academy's headmaster and was adopted, growing up with three Alpha childhood sweethearts. Chloe framed her with forged notes; the three men refused to believe her, torturing her with hockey pucks, dragging her behind a horse, and hanging her from a flagpole. Her heart died, and she chose Bruno, a fallen Alpha. When the truth came out, the three regretted deeply and gave up their Alpha blood to save her—but she never looked back, bonding with Bruno and marrying him.

title: ReelTalk EP 88-Bro Knows Ball
description: Ever wonder what The Big Four really get up to after wrap? We kept the cameras rolling as they took a dip and dove into some heated sports debates.

title: ReelTalk EP 49-Red Carpet Ready with Meg
description: Spend a day with Meg Bush as she gets red carpet ready for the International Short Drama Festival. Go behind the scenes of her glam process and catch the stunning dress reveal before she heads to the event. Stay tuned! You might spot some familiar faces along the way.

title: ReelTalk EP 52 -Backstage: American Sniper: The Last Round
description: ReelTalk Backstage is back and reloaded for the action-packed new series American Sniper: The Last Round. Join Marc Herrmann, Jesse Morales, and Aaron Russell as they take you behind the scenes for explosive moments you won’t find anywhere else. Find out their super powers and maybe even some first impressions of each other!

title: ReelTalk EP 91-Ice Cream & Hot Questions with the Lyonesse Trilogy Cast
description: Cool down from the steamy scenes with the Lyonesse Trilogy’s favorite throuple! Salt Kiss, Honey Cut, and Bitter Burn stars Nico Tortorella, Jake Lively, and Katelynn Rose whip up homemade ice cream while answering some seriously hot questions.

title: ReelTalk EP 53-Happy Holidays, Hollywood
description: Happy Holidays, Hollywood! The first annual ReelShort holiday shoot is here. Your favorite lead stars come together to reflect on their journeys in verticals, share dream collaborations, and spread festive cheer in this must-watch holiday special.

title: ReelTalk EP 90-Salty & Sweet
description: Following the release of the Lyonesse Trilogy, the trio takes their romance from the screen to the ice cream truck. Nico Tortorella, Jake Lively, and Katelynn Rose reimagine their story as a flavor of romance. Sweet, addictive, and unforgettable.

title: ReelTalk EP 78-Day in the Life of Cam: Pop Mart & Untold Stories
description: Spend a day shopping with Cam! Follow along as he searches for Hironos at Pop Mart, shows off his nerdy side, and opens about his journey from modeling to acting. This is a side of Cam you won't want to miss!

title: ReelTalk EP 51-Flashback Friday
description: Who doesn’t love a little nostalgia? Watch as our vertical stars relive their favorite ReelTalk moments with ReelTalk OG Rachel Bencosme. Luke Charles Stafford, Richard Sharrah, Autumn Noel, and Haley Lohrli get heartfelt, hilarious, and everything in between.

title: ReelTalk EP 47-We Mess Up Too...
description: Get ready for an episode full of laughs! This week, we’re reliving the funniest moments and best bloopers from ReelTalk. Which one’s your favorite?

title: The Cartel’s Contract Bride
description: On her wedding day, kindergarten teacher Emma was sold by her fiancé Kyle, who was tangled in gambling debts, to the border group leader Santiago. She was forced to sign a one-year contract marriage and also became the nanny for his niece Sofia, who had developed aphasia after losing her family. While adapting to the dangerous world of the group, Emma helps heal the girl, and they gradually develop genuine feelings amidst numerous crises. Facing attacks from rival Valentina, ambitious brother Nacho, and deadly enemy Emilio, Emma sheds her frailty, learns to use a gun for self-protection, and together with Santiago, crushes their enemies' schemes, breaks the contract's chains, finds true love, and builds a complete family

title: ReelTalk EP 76-Backstage: Taming My Bullies 2
description: Our iconic enemies-to-lovers is back and better than ever! Go behind the scenes of Taming My Bullies 2 and discover how Meg's signature look comes together. Cam also gives the inside scoop on filming some of the shirtless swimming scenes, while the director breaks down the inspiration behind key shots and what it really takes to bring this story to life.

title: The Boy the QB Used in Bed
description: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.

title: My Protective Mafia Lover
description:
Serena Hale was a devoted wife. But her husband hadn't touched her in months. So when a stranger pulled her from a bar one night, she surrendered to him - because in her drugged haze, she thought he was her husband.
One mistake.
That stranger is Evan Knight - the billionaire underworld king now funding her husband's company. He knows she's married. He doesn't care.
He's been waiting for her for sixteen years - since the rainy night she saved a beaten boy in an alley and didn't even remember his face. But he remembered everything. Her piano. Her voice. The way the rain clung to her white dress.
Now he sits across from her at every dinner, watches her husband fake devotion, and whispers: "You don't belong to him."
And the worst part?
She's starting to agree.
Even as she discovers that her husband murdered her parents. Even as she plans her revenge. There's only one man she trusts with the blade.
But trusting him means betraying herself. And she's already fallen for him.

title: Big Molly The Billionaire's Only Cure
description:
Molly Hart runs a street food truck called Big Molly’s Hot Dogs with her adoptive parents. People love to joke about the name—and about Molly herself—but she never lets it get to her. If anything, she turns it into part of the brand.
Meanwhile, Adrian Blackwood, heir to the Blackwood empire, has gone days without being able to eat. The best doctors, private chefs, and nutritionists money can buy have all failed to help him.
Then Charles brings one of Molly’s hot dogs back to the estate. What was meant to be a simple meal unexpectedly catches Adrian’s attention. For the first time in days, he willingly takes a bite—and his condition immediately begins to improve.
The moment Adrian learns the hot dog came from a food-truck girl named Molly Hart, he sets out to find her.
Neither of them expects that a relationship beginning with food, money, and a very unusual arrangement will eventually turn into something neither can walk away from: real dependence, real desire, and real love.

title: A Cinderella for Wolf King
description:
A destitute orphan Layla accidentally stumbles into the Wolf King Kai's suite, and one night soul-binds them. He throws a check at her. She rips it up and slaps him.

A month later, Layla discovers she's pregnant with sextuplets. Her greedy stepfamily sells her for $100,000. Kai transforms into a silver wolf, rescues her, and declares her his destined mate.

Layla joins K-Group on her own merit. Kai secretly courts her. But Kai's rumored fiancée Chloe humiliates Layla—until Kai breaks the engagement publicly.

Chloe colludes with a dark warlock to sell Layla, revealing she's a sacred vessel to break the wolf clan's curse. Kai rescues her and exposes Chloe as an identity thief. Layla is the true Grey heiress, swapped at birth.

Layla delivers sextuplets, ending the curse. From abandoned orphan to matriarch of two clans, she rises to become beloved by all.

title: Forward, Without Him
description: On the day Taylor's Columbia acceptance arrives, she secretly flies to New York to surprise her boyfriend Ethan and best friend Lexi. Instead, she overhears them confess: to grant Lexi's birthday wish, they secretly altered Taylor's application, making her miss the deadline and lose her spot. They've been dating behind her back for a year. Ethan promises Lexi he'll stay hers until fall, then return to being Taylor's boyfriend. Taylor stands outside, holding cupcakes and sunflowers, realizing her entire life was built on their betrayal.

title: Divorced, She Reclaimed Her Empire
description: After ten years of sacrificing her career and inheritance for Julian, Sophie discovers he has kept a mistress, fathered a child, and moved millions while planning to divorce her with almost nothing. Instead of confronting him too soon, she gathers evidence, returns to Whitmore Materials Group as its heiress, exposes his betrayal at a family gala, wins the divorce battle, and takes back the company she helped build—leaving Julian with nothing.

title: I Slept With My Best Friend's Boyfriend
description: I kissed my best friend's boyfriend... because he thought I was her. One mistake should've ended there—until I caught my "perfect" best friend cheating behind his back. Then I heard the truth. "She's boring. Easy to fool." Every kind word, every smile, every year of friendship had been a lie. Now the man I swore to avoid is the only one who knows who she really is. But when he corners me in the dark and asks, "What do you think?"... am I about to betray my best friend—or save us both?

title: Hate to Love You
description: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. After a devastating senior year of high school, Kennedy made two rules for herself. 1. No one will know she's related to her brother and 2. She will never fall for another one of her brother's rivals. When Shay Coleman barges into her life with his irritating and irresistable charm, she's treatened to break both of them...

title: Pregnant with the Dragon Lord's Last Heir
description: Laila, a destitute widow, is forced off a cliff by the tyrannical Governor Barrow—only to fall into the sacred dragon realm. There, she spends one fateful night with King Kael, a dragon sovereign bound by a deadly curse that burns any woman he touches. Ten months later, she gives birth to a royal dragon egg. Hunted by Barrow, she desperately entrusts the egg to the dragon clan. When the temple issues a decree seeking one who can hatch the egg, Laila tears down the royal notice and steps forward. Despite scorn and humiliation from the nobles, she reunites with Kael. In the end, it is her unconditional mother's love that awakens the dying egg—and a penniless commoner becomes the mother of the dragon clan's sole heir.

title: Caught in His Current
description: Leo, the legendary surfing champion, loses his title to a mysterious newcomer named Ruslan. But the biggest shock comes when he discovers that Ruslan is the man from his unforgettable night. Forced into an uneasy partnership, the two rivals find themselves drawn to each other as secrets, danger, and betrayal close in. Behind their battle for glory lies a hidden truth about Ruslan—and their forbidden desire has only just begun...

title: The Dragon Queen's Gambit
description: In The Dragon Queen's Gambit movie, Dragon Queen Evelyn discovers her consort Cyril and handmaid Cecilia, both serpent-shifters, swapped her newborn with their son. She secretly raises her daughter Ann into a northern empire queen. After twenty years of silent endurance, Evelyn abdicates and is exiled. When Ann marries the impostor prince, the trap springs: identity reveal, economic ruin, and the arrival of Millennium Dragon Aurelius as Ann's true father. The betrayers lose everything while Evelyn reunites with her family.

title: My Sex Robot Has My Enemy's Face
description: Reese Calder orders a custom companion android, 006, with the face of Nolan Vance, her spoiled, maddening lifelong rival. By day, 006 cooks, cleans, and kneels when she says, "Down." By night, he breaks every command and makes her forget he is supposed to be a machine. Then Kindred Care texts: "Your companion hasn't shipped yet." Nolan calls it a prank. Miles calls it suicide: "If Reese finds the truth, you're done." But Reese finds the truth anyway, and now the liar is still kneeling.

title: SSS-Rank: The Slum-Born Thunder God
description:
To the world, Nate Ryder is a failure whose Awakening ended in disgrace. But Nate knows the truth: he awakened the SSS-rank Thunder God—the rarest power on Earth.

His father sold his health for a vial of Awakening serum. His mother has been paralyzed for ten years, yet she's the reason he never gives up. At school, the elite bully Tyler—an A-rank prodigy—crushes that serum and works with corrupt administrators to bar Nate from the national tournament.

Facing relentless humiliation, Nate hides his power and bides his time. Every insult, every injustice becomes fuel for his training.

Then the Federal Awakened Selection Tournament begins. Tyler, determined to defeat Nate in front of thousands, steps into the arena—expecting a hopelessly one-sided fight. Instead, Nate unleashes his SSS-rank Thunder God. In one electrifying moment, the "worthless failure" shocks the world—and begins his unstoppable rise to the top.

title: My Sister Stole My Mate, So I Married a King
description: At my own Mate Claim Ceremony, Cassian rejected me and took my sister Maris’s hand, claiming he only wanted to save her from the Council. Then he tried to rip my dead mother’s moonstone necklace from my neck so Maris could wear it as his chosen Luna. The chain broke. So did the last reason I had to wait for him. In three days, the Council would send me to Rowan Vale, the Lycan king’s dying heir. Everyone pitied me. But Rowan was the first man to ask if I chose him freely.

title: The Don's Abandoned Ex-Wife Strikes Back
description: For five years, Serena built Adrian's empire, only to be branded a traitor when he protected his childhood sweetheart. Exiled, hunted, and presumed powerless, she vanishes for three years. Then she appears at a Blackwood underground auction, puts a gun to her rival's head, and claims the castle as her territory. Everyone expects her execution. Instead, the feared Vincent Blackwood steps forward and names Serena as his wife. She did not return for Adrian. She returned with evidence, an army, and a trap for everyone who destroyed her.

title: He Called It a Prank，I Called It Goodbye
description: Avery Ross spent eighteen years as Caleb Bennett's most devoted friend — following him to the same schools, fixing his messes, always there. At their freshman welcome party, he repaid her by pinning her down onstage while his new crush dumped a bucket of red paint over her head. The whole room laughed. Avery didn't cry. She filed her withdrawal papers the next morning and never looked back. Armed with nothing but fury and focus, she threw herself into a brutal gap year — and along the way, found an unexpected rival-turned-anchor in Lucas, a quiet genius chasing MIT. As Avery rises from humiliation to a 1590 SAT score and a Columbia acceptance letter, Caleb spirals into expulsion, debt, and ruin. This isn't a revenge story. It's the story of a girl who decided she was done being the punchline — and became the whole damn headline.

title: 高清The Great and Powerful Genie

title: Traded My Wolves for a Snake
description: Cora took in three wounded wolves and raised them. The moment her sister Vivian appeared, the wolves couldn't look away—they turned cold and rough, trying to break Cora. She overheard them mocking her. So she offered a trade: three wolves for Vivian's snake. Silas the snake was ice-cold, yet he stayed—doing chores, guarding her. When her family forced an arranged marriage, Cora faked agreement, then fled through a window on her wedding day. Silas tracked her to the airport, injuring two wolves who tried to stop him. “You'll never get rid of me,” he said. Cora took over the family business and bonded with Silas. The cold snake was truer than any wolf.
